title: Training, group photos, health data, Starter, patterns, personality, referrals, reminders, cards, voices, and more
summary: Training brings workouts together; requested images can become group photos; health settings and workout timing are clearer; Starter waits until used; patterns link actions to sleep; personality is editable in Settings or chat; referrals stay in their chat; reminders keep local time; cards and voices stay clear; search is current; pages start lighter; and private reports preview their shape.
